Dein Einstieg in High-Performance-Sales
Du willst nach dem Studium nicht Folien bauen, sondern Verantwortung übernehmen? Bei Justhome begleitest du Menschen bei der größten finanziellen Entscheidung ihres Lebens – dem Immobilienkauf. Du arbeitest mit KI-Tools, die dir 70 % der Administration abnehmen, bekommst exklusive, kaufbereite Anfragen statt Kaltakquise und verdienst ab Tag 1 mit an deinem Erfolg.
Wir sind ein kapitalgestütztes Wachstumsunternehmen im Herzen Berlins und digitalisieren die Baufinanzierung – einen Markt, der technologisch Jahre hinterherhinkt. Genau deshalb suchen wir keine klassischen Banker, sondern analytisch starke Absolvent:innen, die schnell lernen und gern verkaufen.
Aufgaben
Beraten & Abschließen: Du verwandelst qualifizierte Kundenanfragen in passgenaue Finanzierungslösungen – im Gespräch per Video und Telefon, ohne Kaltakquise.
Tech statt Tippen: Unsere KI-gestützten Tools strukturieren Daten, formulieren E-Mails vor und bereiten die Einreichung bei über 700 Bankpartnern vor. Du konzentrierst dich auf den Kunden.
Netzwerk nutzen: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren 170+ Partner-Maklerunternehmen zusammen – die technische Integration liefert dir Objektunterlagen oft, bevor du das erste Telefonat führst.
Produkt mitgestalten: Du gibst direktes Feedback an unser Tech-Team und prägst so mit, wie unsere Tools von morgen aussehen.
Qualifikation
Ein abgeschlossenes Studium (z.B. BWL, VWL, Wirtschaftswissenschaften – auch dual) oder eine Bankausbildung
Analytische Stärke, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Empathie, Menschen bei ihrer wichtigsten finanziellen Entscheidung sicher zu begleiten
Hunger, in Rekordzeit zum Finanzierungsexperten aufzusteigen – Vorkenntnisse in Baufinanzierung brauchst du nicht
Wichtig zu wissen: Für den Start brauchst du die Sachkundeprüfung nach §34i GewO – nicht aber für deine Bewerbung. Wir geben dir eine Zusage vorab. Wenn du bei uns einsteigst, erstatten wir dir die Prüfungs- und Vorbereitungskosten im Umfang von bis zu 1.000 €.

Attraktives Gehaltspaket: €60.000 Zielgehalt im ersten Jahr (Fixum + ungedeckelte Provision). Bei sehr guter Leistung sind im zweiten Jahr €70.000–90.000 realistisch - und auch das ist nicht die Obergrenze.
Echte Aufstiegsperspektive: Führungsverantwortung als Teamleiter:in in zwei Jahren ist bei uns ein realer Karrierepfad, weil wir kontinuierlich wachsen.
Hybrid arbeiten: Nach der Probezeit 3 Tage im Loft-Büro am Rosenthaler Platz, 2 Tage Home Office.
Beste Ausstattung: Dein Mitarbeiter-Laptop und unsere starke CRM-Technologie unterstützen dich im Arbeitsalltag
Team, das zusammenhält: Wir feiern Erfolge gemeinsam – zuletzt mit dem ganzen Team beim Bootfahren und Grillen auf der Havel.
So einfach bewirbst du dich
Kein Anschreiben nötig. Schick uns deinen CV oder einfach dein LinkedIn-/Xing-Profil – wir melden uns innerhalb von 48 Stunden zurück.
Wir besetzen zwei Positionen mit frühestmöglichem Start. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

Du verantwortest unser CRM über drei Marken in drei Ländern – analytisch und operativ. Im Zentrum stehen Daten, Logik und Systeme: Du liest aus, wo Potenzial liegt, baust die Segmentierung dahinter und automatisierst, was sich automatisieren lässt.
Copy und Creative-Briefings produzierst du AI-gestützt selbst & erhältst unterstützung aus dem Team wo du es benötigst.
Aufgaben
Volle analytische und operative Verantwortung für das CRM über drei Marken in drei Ländern
Audit und Weiterentwicklung aller Klaviyo-Flows: Trigger-Logik, Segmentierungstiefe, Performance
A/B-Test-Framework etablieren: klare Hypothesen, Mindest-Laufzeiten, Auswertungslogik
AI-gestützte Produktion von Copy und Creative-Briefings über alle Brands
Vollautomatisiertes CRM-Reporting über Klaviyo MCP
Aufbau weiterer CRM-Kanäle: WhatsApp, SMS, Mailing
Qualifikation
Mehrjährige Erfahrung im CRM- oder Lifecycle-Marketing, idealerweise E-Commerce oder D2C
Tiefe Klaviyo-Erfahrung: Flows, Segmentierung, Custom Properties, Events
Du denkst in Daten, Logik und Systemen – nicht in Kampagnen-Ästhetik
Verständnis für Datenmodelle und Tracking: Du erkennst falsch ankommende Events, bevor es jemand anderem auffällt
Du arbeitest AI-first und produzierst Copy und Briefings selbst
Volle Eigenverantwortung: kein Copywriter, kein dedizierter Grafiker im Team
Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Über 1 Millionen Bestellungen, 5 Märkte, 3 Brands – hier passiert was. Du übernimmst echtes Ownership, statt nur Rädchen im Getriebe zu sein.
Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle und Homeoffice-Option. Du entscheidest, wann und wo du am produktivsten bist
Dynamisches Team mit echter Kultur. Wöchentlicher Wanderpokal für gelebte Werte, gemeinsames feiern von Jubiläen und Geburtstagen und monatliche After-Work-Drinks
Deutschland-Ticket, 250 € Shopping-Budget in unseren eigenen Shops und weitere Benefits wie Urban Sports Club M
Jeden Monat eine neue Sportart, die wir im Lyto Athletics Club zusammen ausprobieren
Gemeinsame Team-Trips (Mallorca, Belgien, Portugal) und das beste Company Merch der Branche
Individuelles Coaching nach deinen Zielen – von Leadership bis Fach-Coaching, z. B. ein eigener Google-Ads-Coach

Why NeuraFlash , Part of Accenture: At NeuraFlash , Part of Accenture, we are redefining the future of business through the power of AI and groundbreaking technologies like Agentforce.

As a trusted leader in AI, AWS, and Salesforce innovation, we craft intelligent solutions—integrating Salesforce Einstein, Service Cloud Voice, Amazon Connect, Agentforce and more—to revolutionize workflows, elevate customer experiences, and deliver tangible results.

From conversational AI to predictive analytics, we empower organizations to stay ahead in an ever-evolving digital landscape with cutting-edge, tailored strategies. We are proud to be creating the future of generative AI and AI agents.

Salesforce has launched Agentforce, and NeuraFlash , Part of Accenture, was selected as the only partner for the private beta prior to launch. Post-launch, we’ve earned the distinction of being Salesforce’s #1 partner for Agentforce, reinforcing our role as pioneers in this transformative space.

Be part of the NeuraFlash , Part of Accenture journey and help shape the next wave of AI-powered transformation. Here, you’ll collaborate with trailblazing experts who are passionate about pushing boundaries and leveraging technologies like Agentforce to create impactful customer outcomes.

Whether you're developing advanced AI-powered bots, streamlining business operations, or building solutions using the latest generative AI technologies, your work will drive innovation at scale. If you’re ready to make your mark in the AI space, NeuraFlash , Part of Accenture is the place for you.

As a Salesforce Account Executive, High Tech East you'll work closely with our Sales leadership and be an integral part of the NeuraFlash Sales team. You will manage all aspects of the sales process including lead management, qualification, evaluation, close and account care.

This is an incredible opportunity for someone who is ready to make an immediate impact in their career with a well established brand and dive into the world of AI and Salesforce.

Core Responsibilities: Perform as a key employee in the role of Account Executive, with a focus on winning new business, driving pipeline, and building trust and strong relationships with our customers Tightly partner with the Salesforce Sales and Customer Success organizations including Core AEs & SEs throughout the mid market or enterpise sector of Salesforce Be a quota carrying top sales performer focused on new logos who is looking to learn and innovate to help the company meet its sales and high growth targets Partner with Account Management, Marketing, Sales Engineering, and the CEO to continually take advantage of new market opportunities Commitment to hard work, positive attitude, and continued learning Help maintain updated lead follow-up, tasks, pipeline, and forecasting in Salesforce Continuously ensure the highest possible level of Customer Experience (for NeuraFlash ’s customers, and our partner Salesforce), by delivering quality and timely responses Acquire and maintain all applicable Salesforce certifications Required Experience: 3-5 years of enterprise software sales experience with proven success Industry knowledge and strong network with channel partners (Salesforce) Experience with Salesforce, selling end to end implementations Experience selling complex technology solutions Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience.

Our rich diversity makes us more innovative, more competitive, and more creative, which helps us better serve our clients and our communities. Accenture is committed to providing veteran employment opportunities to our service men and women. What’s it like to be a part of NeuraFlash , Part of Accenture?

Remote & In-Person: Whether you work out of our HQ in Massachusetts, one of our regional hubs, or you're one of over half of our NeuraFlash , Part of Accenture Family who work remotely, we’re focused on keeping everyone connected and unified as one team. Travel: Get ready to pack your bags and hit the road!

For certain roles, travel is an exciting part of the job, with an anticipated travel commitment of up to 25%. So, if you have a passion for adventure and don't mind a little jet-setting, this opportunity could be your ticket to exploring new places while making a positive impact on clients.

Flexibility: Do you have to take the dog to the vet, pick up the kids from school, or the in-laws from the airport? We know that a perfect 9-5 isn’t possible. So you have to jump out to do any of those, no problem! We build a culture of trust and understanding.

We value good work not the hours in which you get it done Collaboration: You have a voice here! If you work with a team of smart people like we do, it’s a no-brainer to take suggestions and feedback on how to keep NeuraFlash , Part of Accenture thriving.

Our executive team holds town halls & company meetings where they address any suggestions or questions asked, no matter how big or small. Celebrate Often: We take our work seriously, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously. Whether it is an arm wrestling contest, costume party, or ugly holiday sweaters our teams love to have fun.

And while we work hard, we don’t forget to slow down and celebrate the big things and the small things together. Originally posted on Himalayas

Who we are Join the fintech revolution with Mambu , the leading SaaS cloud banking platform. We're on a mission to make banking better for a billion people. We're engineering the future of financial services with AI at its core. At Mambu , AI isn't a feature — it's how we're rebuilding banking from the ground up.

If you're ready to apply cutting-edge technology to problems that affect millions of people, your next chapter starts here. Learn more here. As a Channel Account Executive (CAE) at Mambu , you will be on the front lines of our reseller strategy, directly responsible for driving revenue through our valued partner ecosystem.

You're not just managing relationships; you'll be actively selling through our assigned portfolio of reseller partners, helping them identify, qualify, and close new business opportunities. This role is crucial for maximizing our reach and accelerating Mambu 's growth in key markets.

What you’ll do Own and exceed an annual New ACV target by focusing exclusively on driving revenue through your assigned portfolio of reseller partners. Recruit, onboard, and enable new reseller partners, ensuring they are fully equipped and certified to sell, implement, and support Mambu ’s solutions.

Collaborate closely with resellers to manage complex sales cycles, acting as a trusted advisor to key partner stakeholders and assisting them in presenting the full Mambu platform to their end-customers.

Develop and execute joint Go-to-Market (GTM) strategies and business plans with each partner, proactively identifying growth opportunities and mitigating risks. Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with all key partner contacts to ensure a healthy, active, and high-performing channel.

Serve as a direct liaison between the partner and Mambu 's internal teams (e.g., Product, Legal, Professional Services, Customer Success), ensuring partners have the resources and support they need to succeed.

What you’ll bring Proven experience in channel sales, partner management, or indirect sales, preferably within the FinTech or B2B SaaS industry. A proven track record of consistently exceeding sales targets and successfully building a high-performing sales pipeline through a partner ecosystem.

Demonstrated experience in a partner-facing role, with the ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and effectively manage complex partner relationships. Experience selling SaaS or banking products and a strong understanding of how to take a consultative approach to understanding both partner and end-customer needs.

A results-driven mindset with a proactive and tenacious approach to developing and enabling partners to drive sales. Solid technical understanding of SaaS solutions—preferably cloud technology and delivery models—and how they apply to the financial services industry.

What you’ll get Join us to shape the future of banking, where your professional growth is equally as valued as your personal well-being.

Competitive base salary Company equity for all Learning and development opportunities Hybrid/Remote working (location dependant) 60 day working abroad 4 week paid sabbatical after 5 years service Additional benefits based on location Let's connect! Follow Mambu on LinkedIn for the latest Fintech trends and success stories.

Connect with us on Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube to experience our vibrant culture. Explore our mission, values, and the world we're building at mambu.com/careers. Check out our Insights Hub for industry insights, Mambu blogs, webinars, and upcoming events.

As part of the recruitment (or HR onboarding) process, you will be required to obtain authorized criminal background and credit screening results, as well as be queried against a sanctions/anti-money-laundering/counter terrorism financing/politically exposed persons screening service and your employment is conditional upon approval of these results.

At Mambu , we encourage all interested candidates to apply, even if they don't meet every listed qualification, as we value diversity and recognize that experience doesn't always perfectly align with job descriptions.

We are committed to providing equal opportunities for applicants with disabilities; if you need assistance during the application process, please contact talent.acquisition@mambu.com. Originally posted on Himalayas

GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk.

By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation’s top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

The ideal Territory Account Executive will pro-actively network, cold call, and sell to multiple contacts within an organization, including "C" levels. This person will manage and develop relationships with customers and provide a consultative sales approach that delivers the highest level of account management services.

The Territory Account Executive should share the goals and concerns of the client and understand the technology partner and products available to meet their goals and solve their challenges. This is a territory based role focusing on growing existing accounts and adding new mid-market accounts in Maryland/DMV.

This position is virtual/remote with regional travel required. Base salary $50-$100K plus commissions. Role and Responsibilities:
· Consistently meet sales and profitability goals.
· Position, configure and quote product and service solutions to clients.
· Participate in industry organizations such as ISSA, ISACA, OWASP etc.
· Manage leads and opportunities through the companies Salesforce and other CRM tools.
· Accurately and consistently report sales forecasts and opportunity funnels
· Participate in creation, editing and closure of services proposals.
· Work with GuidePoint Security vendors to understand and position their technologies, understand and articulate their value proposition to clients.
· Participate in field marketing to generate interest and provide information to the client prospect community to include driving attendance to such events and activities
· Represent GuidePoint Consultants to clients and be able to articulate our areas of expertise
· Set proper expectations and maintain open communication with clients and vendors through the lifecycle of the sales process.
· Effectively leverage supporting resources in the sales process with the spirit of teamwork and cooperation.
· Professionally develop and present sales presentations to large groups and executive level clients. Position Requirements:
· Minimum 5 years outside sales experience, preferably in cybersecurity or infrastructure and services.
· Current enterprise security space experience preferred
· Strong, established relationships with key accounts in the territory required
· Requires experience with Salesforce.com
· Strong group presentation skills a must
· Verifiable history of exceeding sales goals and generating leads
· Demonstrated ability of lead generation and opening new accounts
· Experience selling professional services, security audits and assessments a plus
· Bachelors degree preferred
· Network security vendor related certifications strongly preferred
· Demonstrates a willingness to learn and use AI-enabled tools We use Greenhouse Software as our applicant tracking system and Zoom Scheduler for HR screen request scheduling. At times, your email may block our communication with you. Please be sure to check your SPAM folder so that you don't miss updates on your application. Why GuidePoint? GuidePoint Security is a rapidly growing, profitable, privately-held value added reseller that focuses exclusively on Information Security. Since its inception in 2011, GuidePoint has grown to over 1,200 employees, established strategic partnerships with leading security vendors, and serves as a trusted advisor to more than 6,200 customers. Firmly-defined core values drive all aspects of the business, which have been paramount to the company’s success and establishment of an enjoyable workplace atmosphere. At GuidePoint, your colleagues are knowledgeable, skilled, and experienced and will seek to collaborate and provide mentorship and guidance at every opportunity. This is a unique and rare opportunity to grow your career along with one of the fastest growing companies in the nation. Some added perks…. Remote workforce primarily (U.S. based only, some travel may be required for certain positions, working on-site may be required for Federal positions) Group Medical Insurance options: Zero Deductible PPO Plan (GuidePoint pays 90% of the premium for employees and 70% for family plans (spouse/children/family) or High Deductible Health Plan with HSA (GuidePoint pays 100% of the employees premiums and 75% for family plans (spouse/children/family). If you choose the High Deductible / HSA plan, GPS will contribute in 4 equal quarterly installments: ($850 per EE annually / $1750 per family annually (includes spouse/children/family options) Group Dental Insurance: GuidePoint pays 100% of the premium for employees and 75% of family plans 12 corporate holidays and a Flexible Time Off (FTO) program Healthy mobile phone and home internet allowance Eligibility for retirement plan after 2 months at open enrollment Pet Benefit Option Originally posted on Himalayas

Who are we? Lightyear builds software that is revolutionizing the telecom management experience for hundreds of enterprises.

Lightyear ’s platform helps enterprise IT teams automate telecom procurement, network inventory management, telecom bill payment, and much more, and is utilized by companies including Honeywell, Alo Yoga, Palo Alto Networks, and Louis Vuitton.

Lightyear has raised nearly $50M from the first investors in Roblox, Discord, Coupang, Robinhood, and Flexport. What’s the role? In this role, you’ll work closely with our VP of Sales and Sales Manager to help us build, execute, and iterate on our enterprise-centric go-to-market playbook.

You will build customer excitement, prospect new customers, close inbound leads, work on outbound strategy, and use learnings to improve and scale our sales organization.

You’ll operate as a core member of our sales team and play an integral role in future hiring, product, and overall strategy, with the opportunity to see significant upward mobility in Lightyear if the fit is strong. We’re looking for someone that’s just as excited about building something as they are about closing big deals.

This position will be full-time, remote , and salaried with $130k-180k+ OTE cash compensation, with additional compensation in equity (compensation determined by experience and fit). You will have the opportunity to move up in our organization much faster than in a traditional AE role.

Responsibilities: Identifying and closing 5-6 figure deals on a 3 week to 4 month sales cycle with mid-market enterprise clients Manage full sales cycle from prospecting to close for target accounts Work closely with marketing and sales to iterate on strategy, content, messaging, potential channels, and sales enablement tools Requirements: 2+ years of sales experience in telecom or B2B SaaS with a record of high performance Excellent communication skills - you write a great email and give an excellent demo Energy, grit, and flexibility needed to thrive in a constantly changing work environment An innate ability to self-start, prioritize, and creatively problem-solve Bonus: experience selling telecom or SaaS to IT professionals is welcome Originally posted on Himalayas

Who We Are At OKX , we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps).

OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me , Do the Right Thing , and Get Things Done .

These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX , OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity We are looking for an Institutional Sales Manager for our Europe/Malta office In this role, you'll be responsible for generating and closing high-value sales opportunities within the EU market, focusing on institutional clients.

You'll develop strategies to build a strong client base, identify new revenue sources, and ensure clients align with OKX ’s standards, while also providing client feedback to senior teams to enhance offerings and drive business growth. What You’ll Be Doing Identify and drive institutional sales opportunities in the EU market.

Build a healthy pipeline through sourcing and converting prospective opportunities from consulting, educating, planning to advisory with institutional clients. Develop client profiling - identify previous success cases and develop them into viable, replicable efforts to repeat success and where marketing efforts should be channelled.

Define and evaluate new revenue streams and opportunities with existing or new clients. Close sales opportunities with particular focus on high revenue, high impact value deals. Ensure prospects or new clients are good standing and will not introduce risk to the OKX business, be it financial reputation, regulatory or others.

Articulate client feedback and gaps in service/product offerings to senior management teams and product related teams with suggested proposals. What We Look For In You Experienced sales professional with proven record of developing and managing partnerships with traditional finance clients and institutions.

Demonstrated strong stakeholder management ability to work closely with cross-functional teams. Extensive knowledge in products that we offer for institutional clients (particularly focusing on Spot). Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong focus on achieving results and driving business growth.

Highly motivated and self-driven with a passion for business development. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, capable of building and maintaining relationships at all levels. Adaptable and resilient, able to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Perks & Benefits Competitive total compensation package L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development Various team building programs and company events Wellness and meal allowances Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants More that we love to tell you along the process!

Mach etwas, worauf du stolz bist. Du möchtest eine gesellschaftlich relevante Marke aufbauen, ihre Geschichte überzeugend erzählen und genau die Menschen dafür gewinnen, die mit Parto wirklich etwas verändern können? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.
Parto ist die digitale All-in-one-Zahlungslösung für Sozial- und Pflegeeinrichtungen. Wir digitalisieren Bargeld- und Zahlungsprozesse, reduzieren Verwaltungsaufwand und schaffen so mehr Zeit für Menschen. Deine Aufgabe ist es, diese Mission sichtbar zu machen, neue Kund für Parto zu begeistern und unser Wachstum aktiv mitzugestalten.
Aufgaben
Als Junior Marketing & Sales Manager*in sorgst du dafür, dass Parto im Markt sichtbar wird, die richtigen Zielgruppen erreicht und aus Aufmerksamkeit konkrete Vertriebschancen entstehen. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Sales-Team zusammen und begleitest potenzielle Kund vom ersten Kontakt bis zur Übergabe in den weiteren Vertriebsprozess.
Marketing & Content
Du planst und betreust unsere Website und Social-Media-Kanäle, insbesondere LinkedIn.
Du entwickelst einen strukturierten Content-Plan und erstellst relevante, zielgruppengerechte Inhalte.
Du konzipierst, erstellst und versendest Newsletter und Marketingkampagnen.
Prospecting & Neukundenansprache
Du identifizierst relevante Zielunternehmen und recherchierst die passenden Ansprechpartner.
Du sprichst potenzielle Kund proaktiv per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn an.
Du führst Cold Calls, qualifizierst erste Bedarfe und vereinbarst Gespräche für unser Sales-Team.
Du entwickelst unterschiedliche Ansprachen und Kampagnen für unsere relevanten Zielgruppen.
CRM & Sales Operations
Du pflegst Kontakte, Aktivitäten und Vertriebschancen sorgfältig in unserem CRM-System.
Du stellst eine hohe Datenqualität sicher und unterstützt uns bei der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer CRM-Prozesse.
Du sorgst dafür, dass Leads strukturiert nachverfolgt und zum richtigen Zeitpunkt angesprochen werden.
Events & Networking
Du planst und organisierst Messeauftritte, Networking-Events und die Teilnahme an Anwendertreffen.
Du koordinierst interne Teams, externe Partner und organisatorische Abläufe.
Du unterstützt bei der Ansprache von Teilnehmenden sowie bei der strukturierten Nachbereitung gewonnener Kontakte.
Analyse & Weiterentwicklung
Du trackst die Wirkung unserer Marketing- und Sales-Aktivitäten anhand relevanter KPIs.
Du analysierst Kampagnen, Kanäle und Ansprachen und leitest daraus konkrete Verbesserungsmaßnahmen ab.
Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und hilfst uns, skalierbare Marketing- und Sales-Prozesse für das weitere Wachstum von Parto aufzubauen.
Qualifikation
Du bist eine kommunikations- und vertriebsstarke Persönlichkeit mit hoher Eigenmotivation . Du hast Freude daran, potenzielle Kund für eine relevante Lösung zu begeistern, überzeugende Inhalte zu entwickeln und messbare Ergebnisse zu erzielen.
Du denkst unternehmerisch, arbeitest strukturiert und bringst eigene Ideen pragmatisch in die Umsetzung . Gleichzeitig hast du keine Scheu davor, zum Telefon zu greifen, neue Kontakte anzusprechen und aus ersten Gesprächen konkrete Vertriebschancen zu entwickeln.
Must-haves
Erste praktische Erfahrung im Marketing, Sales, Business Development oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich – beispielsweise durch Praktika, eine Werkstudententätigkeit oder eine Juniorposition
Freude an der aktiven Ansprache potenzieller Kund per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn
Bereitschaft, Cold Calls zu führen und erste Gespräche mit Interessent souverän zu gestalten
Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke und ein sympathisches, verbindliches Auftreten
Freude am Verfassen überzeugender, zielgruppengerechter Texte
Interesse an Social Media, insbesondere LinkedIn, und an moderner B2B-Kommunikation
Sorgfältige und konsequente Arbeitsweise bei der Pflege von Kontakten und Aktivitäten im CRM-System
Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und KPI-orientierte Arbeitsweise
Organisationstalent und Freude an der Planung und Umsetzung von Veranstaltungen
Hohe Ownership und Hands-on-Mentalität
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
Bereitschaft, Parto bei ausgewählten Veranstaltungen innerhalb Deutschlands zu vertreten
Nice-to-haves
Erste Erfahrung in einem B2B-, SaaS-, FinTech- oder Startup-Umfeld
Erfahrung im telefonischen Vertrieb, Prospecting oder in der Leadgenerierung
Kenntnisse im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen und digitalen Sales-Tools
Erfahrung mit Social Media, Newslettern oder E-Mail-Kampagnen
Kenntnisse in Marketing-, Automatisierungs- oder Analyse-Tools
Erfahrung mit erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten und komplexen Zielgruppen
Gute Englischkenntnisse

As an Account Executive – Mid-Market Hunter, you are a quota-carrying new business sales professional focused exclusively on hunting net-new Mid-Market Business (MM) prospects. This role is 100% hunter-focused and does not carry ongoing account management or expansion responsibilities beyond initial close.

New Logo Acquisition
Prospect, engage, and acquire net-new MM customers aligned to Rithum’s ideal client profile.
Own the full sales cycle from initial outreach through close in a mid-market environment.
Drive consistent new logo bookings through disciplined execution and pipeline management

Demonstrated success as a hunter, with responsibility for self-generated pipeline and new logo acquisition.

Strong executive communication skills across phone, video, and written channels.

What sets us apart
What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

s.h: Meet the team shaping the future of global communication
s.t:
At DeepL, we are on an exciting mission to eliminate language barriers worldwide through AI. As we scale, our Sales team serves as the ultimate driver of our global reach and customer engagement.
Germany is our single largest and most strategic market globally—making this role a pivotal, high-visibility opportunity to shape our growth story. You will join an inclusive, highly collaborative environment where sales partners seamlessly with Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to deliver transformational value to leading organizations.
How you will drive impact
Lead Strategic Growth in Germany: Cultivate deep relationships within our key existing business while identifying opportunities to win new top-tier enterprise clients across the region.
Deliver Transformational AI Solutions: Guide enterprise leaders beyond transactional product use, helping them adopt game-changing innovations like our real-time voice-to-voice lounge to transform their business operations.
Manage Enterprise Sales Cycles: Own the end-to-end journey for high-value prospects, from qualification to close, ensuring a consultative approach aligned with client goals.
Orchestrate Cross-Functional Teams: Partner with our international, welcoming SDR and Marketing teams to build pipeline and deliver custom solutions tailored to complex business needs.
Map Strategic Value: Track and forecast customer insights, purchase timeframes, and emerging use cases to ensure our enterprise partners achieve long-term success.
What will set you up for success
Enterprise SaaS Expertise: Proven track record in complex sales cycles within the DACH region. Industry experience in Finance, High Tech, or Manufacturing is strongly preferred.
Account Expansion & New Business: Experience both growing existing large enterprise accounts and introducing emerging technology to new logos.
Collaborative Mindset: Strong ability to lead, orchestrate, and align internal cross-functional partners to solve big challenges.
Adaptability & Drive: Comfort navigating dynamic, fast-scaling environments with a proactive, solution-oriented approach.
Language Proficiency: fluency in German and English.

Diverse and internationally distributed team : joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback : as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Hybrid work, flexible hours : we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
Regular in-person team events : we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
Monthly full-day hacking sessions : every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
30 days of annual leave : we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.
Competitive benefits : just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.
If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!
We are an equal opportunity employer
You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

You will drive DeepL’s next stage of partner-led growth — establishing new partnerships for our AI-powered productivity solutions and delivering strong, measurable impact on sourced pipeline and Closed Won Business.

Win new high-value partnerships through strategic relationship-building and commercial negotiations. Identify, recruit, and onboard partners with the reach and expertise to drive DeepL’s market expansion across the DACH region.
Manage partner sales performance, ensuring forecast accuracy, pipeline health, and effective execution of agreed revenue targets.
Develop and own the DACH Channel Partner Plan that sets direction for all partner engagement, GTM priorities, and revenue planning, with quarterly business reviews and performance alignment with both partner and internal executives.
In collaboration with Partner Marketing and Enablement teams, own, drive and coordinate and scale programs for onboarding, enablement, co-marketing, and incentives that help partners accelerate pipeline creation and close rates.

Support partner sellers with opportunity qualification, registration, pricing, contract management, and closing support.
Collaborate closely with DeepL’s direct sales and regional leadership to ensure alignment, co-sell readiness, and partner engagement throughout the sales cycle.
Proactively identify and resolve channel conflicts to ensure positive outcomes and trust between DeepL and its partners.
This role reports to the Head of Partner Growth for EMEA and North America, with a close alignment to the DACH Regional Sales Leadership.

Circa 3-5 years of experience in channel or partner sales within SaaS, AI, or cloud technology companies, with a proven record of building and scaling reseller and distribution ecosystems across the DACH region.
Strong commercial background driving multimillion-euro ARR targets through Reseller, Distributor, System Integrator and Cloud partnerships.
Track record of managing strategic partnerships in the region, ideally with established relationships across leading resellers, distributors, or telcos.
Deep understanding of partner GTM motions - sell-to, sell-with, sell-through - and ability to operationalise these models.
Experience building scalable partner programs and working with cross-functional teams (Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Product).
Strong negotiation and relationship management skills, with experience engaging senior executives in complex sales environments.
Knowledge of AI, productivity, or enterprise software markets is a plus and will accelerate time to success.

Acceler8 Labs is where growth gets personal.
We’re a growth marketing company founded by two former Facebookers who decided to build something better after seeing the gap between traditional agencies and the real needs of modern brands.
We believe scale isn’t about bigger budgets but smarter decisions. Our team has helped brands across the globe generate over $1 billion in revenue by combining sharp strategy, bold creativity, and hands-on execution.
We’re designed for the digital era, where everything evolves at the speed of light. Our work evolves alongside it, adapting to the industries, platforms, and audiences we help grow.
We partner with some of the world’s fastest-growing brands, from disruptive startups to global household names, to turn marketing spend into measurable business growth.

We’re looking for a full-time Business Development Manager who can turn great work into consistent growth.
You’ll take qualified opportunities and turn them into long-term client relationships, leading conversations from discovery through to proposal, negotiation, and close. You’ll speak directly with founders, CMOs, Heads of Growth, and other senior decision-makers, digging into how their businesses actually grow and where Acceler8 can make a meaningful difference.
This is a senior, sales-focused role for someone who understands growth marketing beyond the campaign level. You’ll connect paid media, creative, conversion, retention, and measurement to the commercial realities of a business, then translate those opportunities into a compelling reason to work with Acceler8.
You’ll support the top of funnel through prospecting and lead generation, as well as Acceler8’s founders and leadership team on high-value opportunities, proposals, pricing, and closing strategy.

s.h: As a Business Development Manager, you will
s.t:
Take ownership of qualified opportunities, leading the sales process from discovery through to proposal, negotiation, and close
Lead thoughtful discovery conversations with founders, CMOs, Heads of Growth, and other senior decision-makers to understand their business objectives, growth constraints, marketing challenges, and commercial priorities
Look beyond individual campaigns to understand the broader business, including customer acquisition, retention, AOV, CAC or CPA, LTV, MER, ROAS, conversion rate, channel mix, and profitability
Identify where Acceler8 can create meaningful value across paid media, creative strategy, measurement, conversion, channel expansion, or broader growth strategy
Navigate conversations with prospects who may already have an internal marketing team or agency partner, building a credible case for why a different approach may drive stronger results
Develop and present tailored proposals that connect Acceler8’s services directly to the prospect’s business goals and growth opportunities
Partner closely with our Growth Development Representative on lead quality, Ideal Customer Profile refinement, prospect insights, and opportunities moving through the pipeline
Collaborate with Acceler8’s leadership team on sales strategy, pricing, proposals, and high-value opportunities
Maintain disciplined CRM management and accurate visibility across opportunities, conversion, expected revenue, and pipeline health
Use HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Google Workspace, and other sales and prospecting tools to research opportunities and maintain an organized sales process
Represent Acceler8 at conferences, dinners, networking events, and other opportunities to build relationships and strengthen our presence in the market

s.h: You’ll thrive in this role if you
s.t:
Have 5-10 years of experience in business development or sales, including at least 3 years working within a media, advertising, performance marketing, ecommerce, or growth-focused agency environment
Have sold marketing or agency services and understand how DTC and ecommerce businesses grow, not simply how individual advertising campaigns are managed
Can confidently discuss metrics such as revenue, AOV, CAC or CPA, LTV, MER, ROAS, conversion rate, retention, and contribution margin, and understand how they connect to the economics of a business
Understand how paid media fits into a broader growth strategy spanning creative, conversion, retention, promotions, merchandising, CRM, organic channels, marketplaces, and other acquisition channels
Can look at a business, ask intelligent questions, identify potential growth constraints, and translate those challenges into opportunities Acceler8 may be able to solve
Are a strong consultative seller who can build credibility with founders and senior marketing leaders without relying on a scripted pitch
Are comfortable selling into organizations that may already have an agency or internal marketing team and navigating the complexity involved in making a change
Have experience using a modern sales stack, including CRM, lead sourcing, enrichment, LinkedIn prospecting, and pipeline reporting
Have a builder’s mindset and are comfortable being hands-on across research, discovery, proposals, follow-up, negotiation, and closing
Are curious, strategic, tenacious, and organized, and care about winning the right clients and building relationships that last
Live in the US (we’re a remote-first team)
Why Acceler8 Labs ?
We built Acceler8 to bridge the gap between agencies and brands, replacing complexity with clarity and collaboration.
Our model is rooted in three pillars: Fuel (media), Spark (creative), and Insight (analytics), each designed to move faster, think smarter, and deliver measurable impact.
Here you’ll have the room to experiment, fail fast, and learn even faster. Your ideas won’t get lost in a Slack thread. You’ll be part of a team that values transparency, curiosity, and craftsmanship.
We take care of our people so they can take care of their work, their families, and themselves.

Remote workdays so you can design a schedule that works for your rhythm
Comprehensive benefits to make sure you and your family are supported, healthy, and cared for
Learning and certification opportunities to help you grow your craft, not just your title
Real autonomy because we believe in hiring smart people and giving them the space to do great work
The chance to build something that scales for our clients, and for you
If you’re ready to lead a team that’s redefining what performance marketing looks like, we’d love to chat.

s.h: What It’s Like to Work at YipitData

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.
From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention
If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm— YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

s.h: About The Role (and Challenges You’ll Be Helping To Solve!)

We are looking to add an experienced Sales Executive to our team who will act as a main growth driver to position YipitData 's must-have products within the investment field and close on targeted opportunities.
As a Sales Executive, you will be responsible for effectively managing the whole sales process from the beginning to the end, including qualifying new leads, identifying prospects, creating advocates for our products and constantly assisting them find answers to their key questions by collaborating closely with our research and data product teams. Please note that this is a 100% hunting role!
This is a remote-friendly opportunity that can sit in NYC, one of our office hubs, or anywhere else in the US. You have at least 4+ years of experience in enterprise subscription sales

You have successfully introduced a complex product (financial preferred but not required) to new customers
You are a team player and are motivated by the company’s success, not just your own
You are excited about the integration of data and financial analysis

Check out this video to learn why our Revenue team members love being part of YipitData !

Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to self-improve and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.

Founded in 2017, Dutchie is a comprehensive technology platform powering dispensary operations, while providing consumers with safe and easy access to cannabis.

Dutchie aims to further support the positive societal change the cannabis industry brings to the world through wellness benefits, social justice, and empowering local communities through tax revenue.

Build and nurture a strong sales pipeline.

Collaborate with various teams to ensure seamless transitions and timely launches.
Embody Dutchie’s values: It's All About The Customer, “We” Not “I”, Focus On Outcomes, Get There Fast, Embrace Different Perspectives, Get Shit Done, and Be Direct, with Empathy, Utilize First Principles.
Become an expert on the New Jersey Cannabis market

Location: You must live in NJ

TechQuartier For 10 years, TechQuartier has been the place in Frankfurt am Main, Germany, where the right people come together through events, programs, and accelerator initiatives to drive innovative growth.

As a key driver of innovation in Frankfurt’s financial center, TechQuartier connects FinTech and GreenTech startup founders with established companies in future-shaping fields such as AI, quantum computing, and finance. TechQuartier has been part of the Federal Digital Hub Initiative (de:hub) since its start in 2017.

In 2024, TechQuartier was officially recognized as the FinTech Hub Frankfurt within the de:hub network. TechQuartier is also the organizer and host of the IMPACT FESTIVAL in Frankfurt – Germanys largest B2B event for digital & sustainable transformation.

TechQuartier continues to advance the startup ecosystem in the Frankfurt Rhine-Main region and strengthens its role as a central innovation hotspot in Europe.
If you’re interested in taking on responsibility in a dynamic environment, contributing your own ideas, and driving innovation together with us, you’ve come to the right place.
Join our team full-time starting from january 2027 . We look forward to receiving your application.
Why this role truly makes an impact The IMPACT FESTIVAL brings together companies, start-ups, investors, and innovators to drive digital and sustainable transformation forward. To make this happen, it takes strong partners and a diverse range of exhibitors.
As a (Senior) Sales Manager , you will play a key role in acquiring new exhibitors, sponsors, and partners for the IMPACT FESTIVAL. With your instinct for business opportunities and your strong closing skills, you will directly contribute to the festival’s growth and economic success.

This role is not just about managing existing accounts, but about actively creating new opportunities, acquiring a high number of exhibitors, convincing partners, and consistently driving the sales process through to contract signing.
What you will drive forward with us You are responsible for selling our exhibitor, trade fair, sponsorship, and partnership offerings, from identifying and approaching potential customers through negotiation to contract signing.
You build a sustainable sales pipeline by combining inbound leads with proactive outbound activities to acquire new customers.
You develop existing customer relationships, identify cross- and upselling opportunities, and build long-term partnerships.
Together with the team, you further develop our sales strategy and pricing structure and identify new market opportunities.
You confidently lead negotiations with decision-makers, with a strong focus on closing deals, and develop tailored offers.
You ensure a structured handover to the onboarding and account management process and support it as needed.
You manage and document your sales activities in our CRM (Pipedrive) and use the data gained to manage, analyze, and optimize the pipeline.
You work closely with the IMPACT FESTIVAL team and other relevant departments at TechQuartier, ensuring smooth coordination and collaboration.
What you bring to the table You have several years of experience in B2B sales, ideally in the trade fair, conference, event, or sponsorship industry.
You have a proven track record in acquiring new customers and experience in successfully driving complex sales processes through to closing.
You have a strong understanding of customer needs and market potential and bring experience in developing, implementing, and optimizing sales strategies and pricing structures.
You are a strong communicator, approachable, and confident when interacting with a wide range of stakeholders. You communicate fluently in both German and English.
You have strong negotiation skills, take initiative, and work in a structured and goal-oriented manner, while keeping track of multiple sales processes running in parallel.
You are eager to learn and bring a hands-on mentality and a solution-oriented approach.
You are confident working with CRM systems; experience with Pipedrive is a plus.
You are passionate about sustainability, digitalization, and innovation.
Not required, but definitely helpful
You have experience working in a startup or coworking environment and are familiar with the dynamics of agile work cultures.
What awaits you with us Team-Spirit: We are an open‑minded, dedicated, and international team that truly embraces innovation and entrepreneurship. To spark new and creative solutions, we value diverse opinions and perspectives.
Innovation Hub: You will work in a modern and inspiring environment at the heart of Frankfurt’s start‑up ecosystem. Through constant exchange with start‑ups, you’ll discover new trends and technologies, build valuable connections, and take part in numerous events at TechQuartier.
Ownership: From day one, you’ll take responsibility for your own projects, make decisions, and actively shape the future of TechQuartier.
Career & Development: We foster a transparent learning and feedback culture. Clear career levels, skill profiles, and plenty of room for your own ideas help you strengthen your talents and grow personally and professionally.
Flexibility: With your own laptop and a Deutschlandticket, you’re well equipped. Thanks to the option to work partially remote and flexible working hours within our core time, you can organize your day in the way that makes you most productive.
Benefits: 30 days of vacation plus additional days off on Christmas Eve, New Year’s Eve, and your birthday; a company pension plan; shopping and fitness discounts; regular team events; and free drinks.

We’re looking for people with drive, a willingness to learn, and a desire to take on responsibility. Let’s talk and see if we’re a good fit.

Final decision & job offer

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo’s marketplace—shaping how we serve restaurants, grocers, and new verticals worldwide.

From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you.
We’re looking for a Business Development Manager to join our Oxford & South West team. In this role, you’ll help us sign up the best restaurants across Bristol and the South West/Wales region, improving our proposition for customers and identifying ways to continue our fast growth.
Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.
What You’ll Be Doing
You’ll be joining the Regional UK & Ireland team, reporting to the Regional Manager. We are experts in the local markets we serve, and this role is all about being out on the road, finding hidden gems, and being the face of Deliveroo in the South West and Wales.

s.h: Here’s what your day-to-day might look like
s.t:
Strategic Prospecting: Map, prospect, pitch, and close new restaurants across your region, acting as a city-level expert who knows exactly which up-and-coming spots customers crave most.
Multi-channel Outreach: Communicate with restaurant owners through physical visits, calls, and digital platforms to demonstrate the value of Deliveroo’s technology.
Seamless Onboarding: Oversee the partner onboarding process from start to finish to ensure it is as quick, efficient, and seamless as possible.
Performance Monitoring: Ensure restaurant success within the critical first eight weeks of signing to guarantee long-term growth on the platform.
Community Immersion: Attend restaurant and food meet-ups and sample food from high-quality establishments to stay ahead of market trends.
What You’ll Need to Thrive
Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
Sales & Negotiation: Proven experience in targeting new business and the ability to structure win-win deals for both partners and Deliveroo.
Commercial Knowledge: A strong understanding of the economics of food delivery and the ability to work effectively towards demanding monthly targets.
Exceptional Communication: Confidence in building relationships face-to-face, over the phone, and via email with a wide range of stakeholders.
Operational Ownership: A tenacious, self-motivated approach to managing your own territory and taking full ownership of your results.
Mobility: A valid driving licence and access to a car are required, as you will be frequently travelling across Bristol and the surrounding areas.

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.
We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:
🔧 Make a visible impact every day
Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.
🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment
Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.
🧠 Build a career, not just a role
Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.
🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture
Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.
We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here .
Our Global Structure
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.
We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.
If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.
If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

s.h: Who We're Looking For: Digital Marketing Account Manager: REMOTE
s.t:
We’re looking for a high-impact, client-facing Account Manager to serve as the dedicated advocate and primary point of contact for a portfolio of C-4 Analytics ' key clients.

This isn’t a passive coordination role; it’s a proactive, holistic management position where you take full ownership of translating complex business objectives into winning digital marketing programs.

You’ll be expected to master our core services and articulate their value with authority, acting as the strategic bridge between client goals and technical execution.
You’ll operate at the center of the action, driving comprehensive strategies and managing high-stakes campaign tasks across every internal department—from Paid Search and Creative to Content, Local, and Social Media. This role requires a "do-the-work" mentality to ensure every moving part is synchronized and every campaign is delivered with precision. If you’re a natural relationship-builder who thrives on connecting the dots between client vision and digital performance, you’ll do well here.
A day in the life of a Digital Marketing Account Manager: REMOTE
Portfolio & Relationship Management: Serve as the primary advocate and day-to-day contact for a portfolio of 12+ "rooftops," proactively managing client satisfaction and performance to ensure maximum retention.
Strategic Execution & Optimization: Own the full campaign lifecycle—from initial strategy and pitch to setup and execution—across Paid Search, Social, and Web, while conducting regular platform checks to ensure optimal performance.
Data Analysis & Reporting: Utilize Google Analytics and Google Ads to analyze traffic, pitch optimizations, and deliver comprehensive monthly reports that translate complex data into compelling narratives.
Cross-Functional & Third-Party Coordination: Lead internal teams (Creative, Content, Paid Search) and external vendors to ensure timely implementation of strategies and rigorous task tracking within JIRA.
Communication & Presentation: Lead weekly client update meetings and maintain professional, timely communication to keep stakeholders informed on progress and campaign health.
Compliance & Quality Control: Ensure all marketing assets meet brand standards, maintain regulatory compliance, and receive formal client approval prior to launch.
Operational Agility: Handle additional duties as assigned and travel as necessary to support client needs and business objectives.

Must-Haves
3 plus years of Digital Marketing, Account Management or direct Client-Facing experience
Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, a related degree or equivalent relevant industry experience
All different levels of technical digital acumen are welcome (and encouraged!) to apply
Strong presentation skills –ability to demonstrate value to clients and serve as a trusted digital advisor
Excellent written and verbal communication skills – ability to write professional emails to clients and third parties
Demonstrated time management and project management skills
A positive attitude that resonates throughout your team and the company
Demonstrated familiarity with Google products (Gmail, Docs, Slides, Drive) and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) products
Nice-To-Haves
2-plus years' experience building multi-faceted digital marketing campaigns, including SEO, SEM, PPC, Social and email marketing services
Google Analytics & Ads Certifications
Experience using a project management tool, preferably JIRA
Experience working with or in the automotive industry

C-4 Analytics takes the guesswork out of advertising. We don’t over-promise: we over-deliver. We provide real value to our clients because we really value them as partners. Key Account Manager:in (m/w/d)
==============================
Wir machen Medienmachende. Das MAZ ist das führende Kompetenzzentrum für Journalismus und Kommunikation direkt beim Bahnhof Luzern. Als Stiftung unterstützt durch verschiedene namhafte Träger im Medienbereich sorgen wir für die Ausbildung von Berufseinsteigerinnen und Berufseinsteigern, bilden Medienschaffende weiter und trainieren Kommunikationsverantwortliche und Führungskräfte.
Im Zuge der laufenden Organisationsentwicklung suchen wir eine engagierte und selbständige Persönlichkeit als
**Key Account Manager:in**
**Ihre Rolle**
Als Key Account Manager:in am MAZ bauen Sie unsere aktive Kundenakquise insbesondere für massgeschneiderte Angebote auf und entwickeln diese kontinuierlich weiter. Sie identifizieren neue Kund:innen und Marktbedürfnisse und bauen langfristige Beziehungen auf. Von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme über die Offerte bis zum Abschluss sorgen Sie dafür, dass aus Kundenbedürfnissen konkrete Aufträge werden.
**Ihre Verantwortung**
* **Marktbearbeitung:** Sie sprechen Unternehmen, Verwaltungen, öffentliche Institutionen, staatsnahe Betriebe, Verbände, Non\-Profit\-Organisationen, Kommunikationsabteilungen und Medienhäuser aktiv an und gewinnen neue Kund:innen.
* **Kund:innenentwicklung:** Sie identifizieren und qualifizieren Leads, führen Erst\- und Bedarfsgespräche und bauen, in enger Abstimmung mit der CEO, langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf.
* **Angebotsentwicklung:** Sie übersetzen Kundenbedürfnisse gemeinsam mit unserem Chief Product Officer (CPO) und Studienleitungen in passende Weiterbildungsangebote.
* **Offerten \& Abschlüsse:** Sie erstellen und kalkulieren Offerten, fassen systematisch nach und gewinnen neue Aufträge und Wiederholungsaufträge.
* **Sales\-Funnel \& CRM:** Sie bauen einen professionellen Sales\-Funnel auf, pflegen Kund:innendaten und sorgen für klare und verbindliche Nachfassprozesse.
* **Marktfeedback:** Sie bringen Erkenntnisse aus Kund:innengesprächen ins MAZ zurück und liefern damit wichtige Impulse für die Weiterentwicklung und Positionierung unserer Angebote.
* **Kundenbetreuung:** Sie begleiten die Kund:innen vom Erstkontakt bis zur Übergabe an CPO, Studienleitungen und Administration und sorgen für eine konsistente Kundenerfahrung.
**Das bringen Sie mit**
**1\. Verkauf \& Kundenentwicklung**
* **B2B\-Erfahrung:** Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B\-Verkauf, Business Development, Key Account Management oder in der beratungsnahen Kund:innenentwicklung, idealerweise in der Medien\- und Kommunikationsbranche.
* **Beratungskompetenz:** Sie erkennen Kundenbedürfnisse, strukturieren diese und entwickeln daraus gemeinsam mit unseren Fachpersonen konkrete Lösungen.
* **Beziehungsmanagement:** Sie wissen, wie langfristige Kundenbeziehungen aufgebaut, gepflegt und weiterentwickelt werden.
* **Abschlussstärke:** Sie haben Freude an aktiver Marktbearbeitung, verfolgen Offerten konsequent und orientieren sich an messbaren Ergebnissen.
**2\. Markt\- \& Angebotsverständnis**
* **Weiterbildung \& Kommunikation:** Sie interessieren sich für Themen wie Journalismus, Kommunikation, KI, Medienkompetenz, Auftrittskompetenz und Weiterbildung.
* **Konzeptionelles Denken:** Sie können Kund:innenbedürfnisse in passgenaue Angebote übersetzen und arbeiten dafür eng mit internen Fachpersonen zusammen.
* **Sales\-Prozesse:** Erfahrung mit CRM, Sales\-Funnel, Pipeline\-Steuerung und systematischer Angebotsnachfassung ist von Vorteil.
* **Kommunikation:** Sie kommunizieren schriftlich und mündlich stilsicher und erstellen überzeugende Offerten, Angebotsunterlagen und Kundenkorrespondenz.
**3\. Persönlichkeit**
* **Kund:innenorientierung:** Sie haben ein ausgeprägtes Dienstleistungsverständnis und treten gegenüber Geschäftsleitungen, HR, Kommunikationsverantwortlichen und öffentlichen Institutionen souverän auf.
* **Unternehmerisches Denken:** Sie erkennen Chancen, gehen aktiv auf potenzielle Kunden zu und haben Freude daran, neue Märkte zu entwickeln.
* **Verbindlichkeit:** Sie arbeiten eigenständig, strukturiert und beharrlich und behalten Ihre Pipeline im Blick.
* **Teamorientierung:** Sie arbeiten eng mit der CEO, CPO, Studienleitungen, Marketing, Administration und weiteren Fachpersonen zusammen und verstehen Verkauf als gemeinsame Aufgabe.
**Das bieten wir Ihnen**
* Die Möglichkeit, die Marktbearbeitung des MAZ aktiv mit aufzubauen und zu professionalisieren.
* Viel Gestaltungsspielraum an der Schnittstelle von Verkauf, Weiterbildung, Journalismus und Kommunikation.
* Ein breites Netzwerk aus Medien, Unternehmen, Verwaltungen und öffentlichen Institutionen.
* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsleitung, Marketing sowie unseren Studienleitungen und ausgewiesenen Fachpersonen.
* Einen Arbeitsplatz im Herzen von Luzern sowie regelmässigen direkten Kontakt mit Kund:innen in der Deutschschweiz und künftig schweizweit.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo’s marketplace—shaping how we serve restaurants, grocers, and new verticals worldwide.

From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you.
We’re looking for a Corporate Account Manager to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you’ll help us develop and grow a portfolio of key corporate accounts, using data-driven insights to solve workplace problems, retain revenue, and accelerate market expansion.
Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect. https://careers.deliveroo.co.uk/the-commercial-team/
What You’ll Be Doing
You’ll be joining the Deliveroo for Work (DfW) team. We are the dedicated B2B arm of Deliveroo, helping businesses—from tech startups to global law firms—manage their corporate catering, late-night team meals, and employee food perks through a centralized platform.

s.h: Here’s what your day-to-day might look like
s.t:
Portfolio Management: Nurture high-value corporate accounts across the UK, building deep relationships with decision-makers while tracking key usage metrics to identify trends, mitigate risks, and maximize revenue retention.
Strategic Value Creation: Translate commercial data and client behavior insights into tailored account expansion strategies, uncovering growth levers that influence our broader UK B2B roadmap.
Technical Account Leadership: Develop deep product expertise to advise corporate clients on platform best practices, proactively troubleshooting issues to ensure a seamless service experience.
Multilevel Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary trusted partner across your portfolio, aligning your communication style to secure executive buy-in, resolve challenges swiftly, and unlock new partnership opportunities.
Cross-functional & Project Ownership: Collaborate closely with Marketing, Tech, Finance, and Global Commercial teams to champion your portfolio's needs, while leading strategic projects from definition to execution to drive operational efficiency.
What You’ll Need to Thrive
Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
Significant Account Management Experience: Proven track record of managing and expanding corporate client portfolios, with a strong focus on relationship management and driving revenue growth.
Data-Led Commercial Acumen: Confident working with large datasets and translating complex metrics into actionable commercial strategies and structured account plans.
Proactive Portfolio Ownership: Strong capability to work autonomously, take full accountability for business performance, and drive high-impact client engagement.
Senior Stakeholder Engagement: Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, with a proven ability to interface with and influence corporate decision-makers at all levels.
Agility and Collaboration: Solutions-focused mindset with a proven ability to partner effectively with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:
🔧 Make a visible impact every day Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.
🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.
🧠 Build a career, not just a role Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.
🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.
We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.
Our Global Structure
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.
We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.
If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.
If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!
